title: Melee Vortex
summary: Melee Vortex is a Melee Arcane Enhancement that causes kills to an enemy with  Magnetic Status to have a chance to pull in nearby enemies.
extract:
Melee Vortex is a Melee Arcane Enhancement that causes kills to an enemy with  Magnetic Status to have a chance to pull in nearby enemies.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing The Fragmented on Effervo, Deimos.
Awarded for killing Whispers in Albrecht's Laboratories missions.
Awarded for killing Gruzzlings in non-Disruption Albrecht's Laboratories mission.
Can be bought from Bird 3 of  Cavia for  7,500, requiring Rank 4 - Scholar.
Dropped by Captain Vor in Tolstoj (Mercury) in The Steel Path.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
The  Magnetic Status does not need to be inflicted by the weapon this Arcane is equipped on.
For example, a Robotic Companion equipped with  Manifold Bond, a compatible precept ( Arc Coil,  Synergized Prospectus etc.), and its weapon modded for  Magnetic will reliably inflict enemies with the Status.
